metadata.question: Were blooms of phytoplankton visible in the Norwegian Sea during June 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about phytoplankton blooms in the Norwegian Sea on June 5, 2019. Phytoplankton blooms can be detected using satellite imagery through chlorophyll-a concentrations or ocean color indices. Strategy: 1. Use MODIS Ocean Color data (MODIS Aqua) which is specifically designed for ocean monitoring and has chlorophyll-a bands 2. Define a region covering the Norwegian Sea 3. Get imagery for June 5, 2019 4. Check if chlorophyll-a concentrations indicate phytoplankton blooms (typically > 1 mg/m³ is considered bloom conditions) 5. Validate data availability and pixel counts Data considerations: - Use MODIS Aqua Ocean Color (chlorophyll-a band) - Norwegian Sea region: roughly between 62°N-72°N and 0°E-15°E - Check for valid pixels after masking clouds/land Logic: - Get chlorophyll-a values - Check if mean chlorophyll > threshold (e.g., 1 mg/m³) - Validate data exists and has sufficient pixels ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const norwegianSea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[0, 62], [15, 62], [15, 72], [0, 72], [0, 62]] ]); const date = '2019-06-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua Ocean Color for chlorophyll detection const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterBounds(norwegianSea) .filterDate(date, '2019-06-06'); // Check if collection is empty const colSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Images on ${date}: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the image and chlorophyll band const image = modisCol.first(); const chlorophylla = image.select('chlor_a'); // chlorophyll concentration // 3. Processing - Check valid pixels const pixelCount = chlorophylla.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid chlorophyll pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean chlorophyll concentration const meanChl = chlorophylla.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean chlorophyll (mg/m³): ${meanChl ? meanChl.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer // Check for valid calculation and bloom conditions // Chlorophyll > 1 mg/m³ typically indicates bloom conditions if (meanChl === null || meanChl === undefined || isNaN(meanChl) || meanChl < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (meanChl > 1.0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
